snippet.title: FIGHT-QUEST | Epic MegaGrant Trailer
snippet.description:
FIGHT-QUEST aims to fuse Balatro and ULTRAKILL into an action-packed first-person rougelike with massive enemy hordes and game-changing upgrades.

Looking for funding via Epic Megagrants. Using Unreal Engine physics and features, we aim to create a unique fusion of retro graphics with modern, cutting edge graphical capabilities.

SUBSCRIBE FOR UPDATES
